skill.disclaimer.en: A record of past forecasts at the buoys, not a promise about the next trip.

skill.future.en: The publish time on this scorecard is in the future, so its age and windows cannot be trusted.

skill.intro.en: How often our forecast was close to what a buoy then measured, for the buoys that stand in for each port. A forecast counts as right when it is within the stated tolerance of the reading nearest its valid time. The record covers the last 7 days and, beside it, the last 30 days; each figure shows how many forecasts it rests on. Forecasts from every model we collect are counted together. Until a window has enough history (30 distinct forecast hours across at least 7 days and 3 model runs) it reads “not enough data yet” and shows no percentage.

skill.unreadable.en: The scorecard could not be read. No scores are shown.

skill.unscored.en: Swell period and water temperature are not scored yet. Neither is checked against buoy readings today, so this page makes no claim about how often they were right.
